message:
Running command: cat >/workspace/terminate_updates.sh <<'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
PATTERN='(update|apt(-get)?|aptdaemon|aptd|unattended|unattended-upgrade|packagekit|snapd)'
LOG=/workspace/terminate_updates.log
echo "==== terminate_updates run at $(date) ====" >> "$LOG"
matches=$(ps -eo pid,user,comm,args --no-headers | grep -E -i "$PATTERN" | grep -v grep || true)
if [ -z "$matches" ]; then
  echo "No matching update-like processes found." | tee -a "$LOG"
  exit 0
fi
echo "Found matching processes:" | tee -a "$LOG"
echo "$matches" | tee -a "$LOG"
if [ "${AUTO_CONFIRM:-}" != "1" ]; then
  read -p "Proceed to terminate these processes? (y/N) " ans
  if [[ "$ans" != "y" && "$ans" != "Y" ]]; then
    echo "Aborting." | tee -a "$LOG"
    exit 0
  fi
fi
pids=$(echo "$matches" | awk '{print $1}' | tr '\n' ' ')
for pid in $pids; do
  echo "Sending TERM to $pid" | tee -a "$LOG"
  sudo kill -TERM "$pid" 2>>"$LOG" || true
done
sleep 3
for pid in $pids; do
  if kill -0 "$pid" 2>/dev/null; then
    echo "PID $pid still alive; sending KILL" | tee -a "$LOG"
    sudo kill -KILL "$pid" 2>>"$LOG" || true
  else
    echo "PID $pid terminated" | tee -a "$LOG"
  fi
done
echo "Done" | tee -a "$LOG"
EOF
chmod +x /workspace/terminate_updates.sh
AUTO_CONFIRM=1 /workspace/terminate_updates.sh
